source_manifest.selection_basis: manifest.jsonl PMCID join; every row retained

method.selection: manifest-order append with existing selection rows preserved
method.classification: metadata/headings/abstract cues only; labels are selection cues, not semantic interpretation
method.packet: complete non-reference section text, chunked with stable S###:C## locators
method.recovery: selection.jsonl is the durable ledger; packets are atomically replaced; cards are create-if-absent
